rules.name: High FIT + Symptoms → Urgent Referral
rules.description: IF: FIT > 100 AND (ChangeInBowelHabit OR RectalBleeding OR UnintentionalWeightLoss) THEN: Urgent Referral recommended

guidance.text_template: Urgent two-week-wait referral recommended. FIT result {fit_value} µg Hb/g is elevated, combined with presenting symptoms (change in bowel habit, rectal bleeding, or weight loss).

rules.name: Iron Deficiency Anaemia + Family History → Lynch Syndrome
rules.description: IF: IronDeficiencyAnaemia AND FamilyHistoryOfColorectalCancer THEN: Consider genetic testing for Lynch syndrome

guidance.text_template: Consider genetic testing for Lynch syndrome. Patient has iron deficiency anaemia and family history of colorectal cancer.

actions.description: Consider genetic testing for Lynch syndrome

rules.name: Low Haemoglobin + Low Ferritin → Iron Treatment
rules.description: IF: Haemoglobin < 120 AND Ferritin < 30 THEN: Consider iron supplementation

guidance.text_template: Consider iron supplementation. Haemoglobin {hb_value} g/L and Ferritin {ferritin_value} µg/L are below normal ranges.

actions.description: Consider iron supplementation for iron deficiency anaemia

rules.name: Positive FIT → Colonoscopy
rules.description: IF: FIT > 10 THEN: Colonoscopy investigation recommended

guidance.text_template: Colonoscopy investigation recommended. FIT result {fit_value} µg Hb/g is positive.

rules.name: Multiple Risk Factors → Enhanced Monitoring
rules.description: IF: ≥3 risk factors THEN: Enhanced monitoring recommended

guidance.text_template: Enhanced monitoring recommended. Patient has {risk_factor_count} risk factors for colorectal cancer.

actions.description: Enhanced monitoring and safety netting required. Patient has {risk_factor_count} risk factors. Advise patient to return if symptoms worsen or new symptoms develop.
